title: Aurora curtain
description: Soft green filaments rise from a luminous, slowly folding hem as activity changes the curtain’s shape.
useCase: Shape a nocturnal atmospheric backdrop without changing its framing.
interaction: Adjust activity; pause or resume the curtain
reducedMotion: Ambient motion stops; activity still redraws the curtain geometry and light immediately.
limitations: Original stylized emission field, not a physical aurora simulation. Native WebGL1 with static fallback; remount after context loss.
look: Deep blue-black night sky with faint stars and layered glowing green curtains of fine vertical filaments rising from wavy luminous hems.
motion: Three noise-driven curtain layers slowly bend and fold while their filaments shimmer; the activity slider speeds the drift, deepens folds, and lengthens and brightens the rays.
adapt: The curtain is the `FRAGMENT` shader: three `layer` passes build `hem`, `veil` and `lip` from `noise`, and `u_control` scales speed, folds, height and brightness. Retint via `tint`; keep `sg-aurora-curtain-fallback`, context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
